name: Super Mario Land Game Boy re-implementation (GBDK)

mentions.name: Super Mario Land Game Boy re-implementation (GBDK)
mentions.description: This project re-implements Super Mario Land for the Game Boy in C using the GBDK toolkit, producing a ROM that runs on original Game Boy hardware. Scrolling and background collision are implemented, and drawing enemies is in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a super mario land re-implementation for game boy using C. It's  made with the GBDK toolkit so the ROM can be run on a gameboy.
